transcript: Speaker A: रोटी बेल रही हूँ और तुम्हें वो दिन याद आ रहा है जब बच्चे ने बोला मम्मी तुम पीटीएम मीटिंग में मत जा इंग्लिश में बात होती है तो चुप बैठती है मुझे एंबेरेसमेंट होती है... [I am rolling chapatis and remembering when my child told me not to attend school meetings because my lack of English embarrasses him. I felt left out of a world that runs on English. Then I found the English Seekho app. I started practicing daily while doing kitchen chores—cutting veggies, rolling chapatis, and washing dishes. I practiced sentences and spoke with the AI coach at night. A month later, I confidently spoke English with my husband's colleagues, making him proud. Now I am no longer silent.] Speaker B: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पर क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW, [Disclaimer: English Seekho is not affiliated with any government authority or brand. Content is for educational purposes and results may vary based on individual effort.]
summary: A housewife shares her story of overcoming the shame of not knowing English after her child expressed embarrassment. She explains how she used the English Seekho app to practice English during her daily kitchen chores, eventually gaining confidence and pride. The ad ends with a call to action to download the app.
